canonical_title: Workplace Considerations: Workspace and Location of Equipment
aliases: Rules for locating fixed workshop machinery

one_line_answer.text: If work is to be performed in a safe manner, sufficient space should be allocated.

cites.quote: If work is to be performed in a safe manner, sufficient space should be allocated.

keywords.bn: desk, bench, machinery বাদ দিয়ে খালি জায়গা
মেশিনের ঘূর্ণায়মান অংশ ঢাকার নিরাপত্তা আবরণ

bangla_explanation: নিরাপদে কাজ করতে হলে প্রত্যেক trainee-র জন্য যথেষ্ট জায়গা লাগে; workstation-এর চারপাশে চলাফেরায় বাধা থাকা চলবে না।
Clear space মানে desks, benches, machinery বাদ দিয়ে খালি জায়গা; aisles আর passageways এর বাইরে আলাদা হিসাব হয়।
Fixed machinery বসানোর পাঁচটা নিয়ম আছে: দূরত্ব ও safety switches, barriers ও guards, stop buttons, fume ও dust extraction, আর lighting।
Supplier বা manufacturer demonstration-এর জন্য মেশিন দিলে কে কীভাবে ব্যবহার করবে তা লিখে নিতে হয়; signed letters of agreement জরুরি।

example.en: A TTC welding shop keeps clear aisles between machines. Each grinder has a working guard and stop button.
example.bn: TTC-র welding shop-এ মেশিনের মাঝে চলার পথ খালি, প্রতিটি grinder-এ guard আর stop button ঠিকমতো কাজ করে।

mnemonic.text: D-G-S-F-L: Distance, Guards, Stop buttons, Fume extraction, Lighting.
mnemonic.explain_bn: পাঁচটি নিয়মের প্রথম অক্ষর: দূরত্ব, guard, stop button, fume/dust extraction, lighting।

list_answer.title: Rules for the safe and efficient location of fixed workshop machinery
list_answer.title_bn: Fixed workshop machinery নিরাপদে বসানোর নিয়ম

items.text: Adequate distance exists between machinery. Safety switches operate effectively on all machinery.

cites.quote: Adequate distance exists between machinery, and safety switches operate effectively on all machinery.

items.text: Safety barriers are correctly placed. Machine guards are in proper working order on all machinery.

cites.quote: Safety barriers are correctly placed and machine guards are in proper working order on all machinery.

items.text: Rotating machinery is properly guarded. Machinery stop buttons are adequate and in proper working order.

cites.quote: Rotating machinery is properly guarded and machinery stop buttons are adequate and in proper working order.

items.text: Fume and dust extraction facilities are adequate for the size of the workshop. They are in proper working order.

cites.quote: Fume and dust extraction facilities are adequate and in proper working order for the size of the workshop.

items.text: Adequate lighting is provided in booths or compartments where work is performed.

cites.quote: Adequate lighting is provided in booths or compartments where work is performed.

items_bn: মেশিনগুলোর মাঝে যথেষ্ট দূরত্ব রাখতে হবে, আর প্রতিটি মেশিনের safety switches ঠিকমতো কাজ করতে হবে।
Safety barriers ঠিক জায়গায় থাকবে, আর machine guards সব মেশিনে কাজের উপযোগী থাকবে।
ঘোরে এমন (rotating) machinery ঢাকা থাকবে; stop buttons যথেষ্ট ও সচল থাকবে।
ধোঁয়া (fume) আর ধুলা (dust) বের করার ব্যবস্থা workshop-এর আকার অনুযায়ী যথেষ্ট ও সচল থাকবে।
যে booths বা compartments-এ কাজ হয়, সেখানে যথেষ্ট lighting থাকবে।

traps.text: Clear space excludes desks, benches, machinery and any other fittings.

cites.quote: The clear space should be exclusive of desks, benches, machinery and any other fittings.

traps.text: Aisles, passageways and access to cupboards or doors are in addition to clear workstation space.

cites.quote: Aisles, passageways and access to cupboards or doors should be in addition to the calculated clear workstation space.

traps.text: Heat or noise may require increases to the recommended size.

cites.quote: Environmental problems such as heat or noise may also require increases to the recommended size.

traps.text: Signed letters of agreement are essential to protect the rights of all concerned.

cites.quote: Signed letters of agreement are essential to protect the rights of all concerned.

rows.text: Movement around workstations should be unhindered by equipment, materials or other trainees.

cites.quote: Movement in and around workstations should be unhindered by workshop equipment, materials or other trainees.

rows.text: Local regulations will apply to actual space allowable.

cites.quote: Local regulations will apply to actual space allowable.

rows.text: Operate machinery and power tools by workshop policy and manufacturer's recommendations.

cites.quote: Fixed machinery and portable or hand-held power tools must be operated in
accordance with established workshop policy procedures and machinery manufacturer's recommendations.

rows.text: Any faults identified in operation must be reported to the appropriate authority.

cites.quote: Any faults identified in operation must be reported to the appropriate authority.

rows.text: Suppliers or manufacturers may place machinery in the workshop for demonstration purposes.

cites.quote: Arrangements may be made with suppliers and/or machinery manufacturers to place items of machinery or equipment in the training workshop for demonstration purposes.

rows.text: Clear instructions for the use of demonstration equipment must be established

cites.quote: Clear instructions for the use of demonstration equipment must be established

short.prompt: State the rules for the safe and efficient location of fixed workshop machinery.
short.modelAnswer:
Rules for locating fixed workshop machinery:
1. Adequate distance between machinery; safety switches work on all machinery.
2. Safety barriers correctly placed; machine guards in proper working order.
3. Rotating machinery properly guarded; stop buttons adequate and working.
4. Fume and dust extraction adequate and working for the workshop size.
5. Adequate lighting in booths or compartments where work is performed.
